title: Provider-neutral semantic control plane
description: Stable semantic objects that a carrier pack maps to provider-native pages, databases, collections, or files.

objects.name: System Manifest
objects.purpose: Canonical map of the instance, carrier roles, active architecture, routing rules, and lifecycle boundaries.

objects.name: Bridge Registry
objects.purpose: Cross-carrier references, relationship type, authority, synchronization posture, and reconciliation state.

objects.name: Garden Pass History
objects.purpose: Durable record of reconciliation, architecture change, migration, validation, and retirement work.

objects.name: Domain Index
objects.purpose: Stable identities, purposes, classifications, lifecycle, routes, and relationships for approved durable domains.

objects.name: Artifact Registry
objects.activation_condition: The approved profile contains reusable prompts, skills, macros, code, schemas, templates, or other versioned artifacts that benefit from semantic discovery.
objects.purpose: Semantic catalog pointing to canonical versioned artifacts without duplicating their complete source.

relations.purpose: Associate bridges with the domain they serve.
Record which domains were affected by maintenance.
Group reusable artifacts by durable domain.

recommended_views.name: Needs Attention
recommended_views.filter: Status is Conflict, Stale, Missing, or Review

recommended_views.name: Artifacts Due for Review
recommended_views.filter: Status is Review or Last Reviewed is overdue

rules: Relations are preferred over deep folder nesting.
Versioned source remains in the versioned-artifact carrier; the control plane stores summaries and references.
Exact existing matches are reused; ambiguous matches are never silently merged.
